info.name: WebSankul API — Complete 2026
info.description:
Production-ready Postman collection for the WebSankul ed-tech platform.

4 API surfaces: Client (Mobile/Web), Admin, Educator, Promoter.

SETUP (3 steps):
1. Import this file + WebSankul.postman_environment.json
2. Set base_url = http://localhost:3000/api/v1
3. Run login request for your surface — token auto-saves to environment

TOKEN FLOW:
- Client: POST Validate OTP → saves client_token + client_refresh_token
- Admin: POST Login (Admin Auth) → saves admin_token + admin_refresh_token
- Educator: POST Login (Educator Auth) → saves educator_token
- Promoter: POST Login (Promoter Auth) → saves promoter_token

REQUEST CHAINING: Test scripts auto-capture IDs (course_id, order_id, razorpay_order_id, etc.) into environment variables for subsequent requests.

RESPONSE ENVELOPE: { success, code, data, message, messages }
ERRORS: 400 bad request, 401 unauthorized, 403 forbidden/gated, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 422 validation, 500 server error

Home dashboard. Returns { todayDate, logo, unreadNotifications, dashboard[], testimonial }. The dashboard[] array holds ordered sections (each pushed only when non-empty), keyed by `type`: banner (Banner), exam-countdown (Exam Countdown), daily-test (Daily Test), package (Recently Added), course (Course Subjects), courseCategory (Course Categories), trending-book (Trending Books), trending-ebook (Trending Ebooks).

Home-screen Resume UI. Returns { resumeLecture, recentPackage, recentCourse } — all derived from LectureProgress.lastWatchedAt (most-recent live lecture + most-recent package + most-recent recorded course).

Free dashboard. Returns { todayDate, logo, dashboard[] }. dashboard[] sections (each pushed only when non-empty), keyed by `type`: trending-book (Trending Free Books), trending-ebook (Trending Free Ebooks), free-ebook (Free Ebooks), video (Free Videos).

item.name: 🔔 Client Notifications
item.description: In-app notification feed: list, mark read, delete (single/multi/all), and active banner images.

request.description: Delete (dismiss from my feed): single/multi/all in one endpoint. Body { "ids": number[] } dismisses those ids (single = one-element array), or { "all": true } dismisses the whole visible feed. Returns { success, deleted, message }.
Bootstrap-gated: public only on first run.
